doctrines.note: Veterancy: Bot Line. Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. Thread title is 'Wuxing Spirit' (tierlist assigns this to 'Wuxing Pikemen'). Playstyle: mastery allows the unit to do serious DMG to high-tankiness units (Spartan Chosen, Iron Reapers, etc.); X-move close, press 2, let the animation go on, press 1. No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle bullets (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Filler'/'Don't put' are literal X placeholders in the OP. Wuxing Pikemen is on the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch shortlist: "Fiery Blast" radius +20%, now activates instantly (was delayed) (Buff/Rework). This build/usage was drafted from a guide edited 2026-05-27, before the patch anchor -- the guide predates the rework entirely and never once mentions a "Fiery Blast" skill anywhere in its text (confirmed absent from Overview, Playstyle, Doctrines, and Ability infos). The Playstyle/Doctrines guidance is therefore incomplete for the current season, not just outdated: it cannot describe engage timing around the new instant-activation Fiery Blast because the guide's author had not yet seen the rework.
